text:
这是同一份 14 页中文路演 PPT 的修版复验，只判定修改过的两页（其余 12 页已通过）。设计口径：13.333×7.5 英寸，MiSans，暖纸底 + 墨黑 + 朱红。

PNG：
/tmp/ppt_build/render/slide-06.png
/tmp/ppt_build/render/slide-08.png

slide-06 原问题是第 4 台设备截图压住右列文字，已改为 3 台设备并留出间距；slide-08 原问题是地图截图裁到卡片边缘像未完成，已改为纯瓦片区域裁切并在图注写明“局部”。

请只依据 PNG 判断：文字是否溢出/遮挡、设备与图片比例是否正常、版面是否平衡、图注与图片是否匹配。每页一行 JSON：{"page":N,"verdict":"pass|fail","issues":[],"fix":""}，最后一句总体判断。

thinking: Let me review the two PNG pages assigned to me. I need to read them one by one and give verdicts.

Slide 06: The fix was to change from 4 devices to 3 devices with spacing. I see 3 device screenshots (P05 仪表台, P03 全数字, P07 菜单) side by side, none overlapping the right column text. The right column has 图形栈, 信息架构, 半透半反, 图标 sections with text. No overlap visible. Devices look natural aspect ratio — they look like landscape-ish watch/bike computer screens with rounded dark bezels, appear consistent. The status bar strip below with "19:40" and icons, caption "状态栏五态..." matches. Layout balanced: left visual column, right text column. Right column bottom has empty space below 图标 section, but left column also ends around same area ("同一份 LVGL 源码， PC 模拟器逐页渲染。"). The right column ends at ~860px while left ends ~910px. That's fine. The right side lower area (below 图标 line) is empty from ~900 to 1090, but the left column text ends at similar height. Looks balanced enough. Third device screenshot: the 菜单 screen — bottom shows "系统" label and a partially cut "界面" text at the bottom edge of the bezel? Looking at the third device, at bottom there's "系统" and below it partially visible text "界面" that appears clipped by the device frame bottom. Hmm, let me look closer. The third device shows 菜单 screen with 导航 highlighted, 设备 section with 蓝牙设备 and 工具箱, then 系统 label and a sliver of another row cut off at bottom edge. This is within the screenshot itself — the screenshot is cropped so a menu row is partially visible at the bottom edge of the device. Is that a defect? It's inside the image asset. The device screenshot appears to be a real UI screenshot that extends beyond the visible area — the "界面" text is partially cut. But this mimics a real scrollable menu screen; the device frame crops it naturally. Actually in a bike computer UI, the list would scroll; a partial row at the bottom edge is natural for a real screenshot. It doesn't look like deformation or bad cropping of the image asset — the image fills the device screen. I'd consider it acceptable — it reads as a real screen capture with a scrollable list. Not stretched, not squashed.

Devices P05 and P03 look complete. Aspect ratios: all three devices similar landscape shape, consistent.

Text overflow: none visible. Right column text: "LVGL 9.5 + EPIC GPU ；双 SRAM 条带 + LCDC DMA 局部刷新" fits on one line. Fine.

Slide 08: The map screenshot — caption says "P04 · 地图页局部：真机矢量底图" which states 局部 (partial). The map is a pure tile area crop with status bar at top. The map fills the frame; at bottom, "200m" scale bar and some road labels (蜀, 樊洼路, 通用 partially cut at edges) — but since caption says 局部 (crop of a larger page), that's declared. The 200m scale label appears slightly cut at right edge? It shows "200m" with the bracket partially near edge. It's within the image. Caption matches image (地图页局部). Aspect ratio normal — map area not stretched. Layout: left image with caption, right stats list (7.8 GB, 5,925 块, 13 km, 50–150 ms) with rules. Balanced. Bottom right text "3 km 网格 · 256×256 矢量瓦片 · z14" and "只平移不解码；20 ms 泵 / 2 块 / 8 ms 预算". Page number 08/14.

One thing: the map image left edge — the map starts at x~105 and the status bar spans across. The bottom edge of map at ~940, caption below. Looks clean. The "200m" scale bar at bottom right of image is partially cut by image edge? It looks like "200m" is fully visible with scale bar line. There's "蜀" character at right edge partially — vertical text cut at edge, but that's part of the tile crop, declared as 局部. Acceptable.

Both pass.

Output format requested by the dispatcher: {"page":N,"verdict":"pass|fail","issues":[],"fix":""} per page, plus a final overall sentence. The dispatcher's format slightly differs from my system format (includes "fix" and "issues" always). I'll follow the dispatch format since it directs my work, one line per page, then overall judgment sentence.
